title: Adversarial Entropy Inflation Against Gumbel-Based Inference Verification
abstract: arXiv:2608.23375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gumbel-based inference verification bounds LLM weight exfiltration by only forgiving token choices that plausibly arise from honest GPU nondeterminism, reporting a >200x slowdown for a steganographic adversary under benign prompt traffic. This bound assumes a passive attacker; we show it degrades sharply against an adversary who instead controls the prompt distribution. Because the verifier's admissible-token-set size is driven by the model's own output entropy, prompts engineered to break grammatical and sub-word structure -- rather than benign conversational traffic -- widen that set and open a materially larger covert channel. Across six instruction-tuned models spanning 1B to 32B parameters and three random seeds, our strongest attack (character- and script-level disruption) roughly doubles bits leaked per token relative to benign prompts, cutting the slowdown factor to 60x - 118x. translated_title: 基于Gumbel推理验证的对抗性熵膨胀攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23375v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于Gumbel的推理验证通过仅容忍那些可能源于诚实GPU非确定性的令牌选择，来限制LLM权重外泄，在良性提示流量下，对隐写术攻击者报告了超过200倍的减速效果。该界限假设攻击者是被动的；我们表明，当攻击者转而控制提示分布时，该界限会急剧退化。由于验证器的可接受令牌集大小由模型自身的输出熵驱动，旨在破坏语法和子词结构的提示——而非良性对话流量——会扩大该集合，并打开一个实质更大的隐蔽通道。在六个指令调优模型（参数范围从1B到32B）和三个随机种子中，我们最强的攻击（字符和脚本级破坏）相对于良性提示，每令牌泄露的比特数大约翻倍，将减速因子降至60倍至118倍。这些结果表明，静态的良性流量假设不再成立。
tldr: 本文证明基于Gumbel的推理验证在攻击者控制提示分布时失效，通过破坏语法和子词结构的对抗性提示可扩大隐蔽通道，将减速因子从200倍以上降至60-118倍。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that Gumbel-based inference verification fails when the adversary controls the prompt distribution, as adversarial prompts breaking grammatical and sub-word structure widen the covert channel, reducing the slowdown factor from over 200x to 60-118x.
